description: This file is a source documentation and specification for an automated GitHub issues management and PR handling workflow, describing phases, steps, and detailed logic for parsing arguments, fetching issues, pre-flight checks, spawning sub-agents, review handling, and optional watch mode.

classes.name: Issue
classes.description: Represents a GitHub issue with attributes like number, title, body, labels, assignees, and URL.

classes.name: PullRequest
classes.description: Represents a pull request with attributes like number, branch, URL, title, and body.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment (review or inline) with attributes like ID, user, body, file path, line number, and source.

methods.name: parse_arguments
methods.description: Parses the supplied /gh-issues arguments string to extract owner/repo, flags, and options, storing them for subsequent steps.

methods.name: fetch_github_issues
methods.description: Uses curl and the GitHub API to fetch issues based on parsed filters, filtering out pull requests, and handling errors like authentication issues.

methods.name: present_and_confirm
methods.description: Displays a table of fetched issues, prompts for user confirmation unless --yes or --dry-run flags are set.

methods.name: preflight_checks
methods.description: Performs checks like uncommitted changes, remote reachability, token validity, existing PRs, branches, and claim-based concurrency control.

methods.name: spawn_subagents
methods.description: Spawns parallel or sequential sub-agents for issues, manages thread/process limits, and respects --cron, --reviews-only flags.

methods.name: collect_results
methods.description: Collects completed sub-agent results, PR links, statuses, and summarizes final outcomes.

methods.name: pr_review_handler
methods.description: Monitors open PRs for review comments, analyzes for actionability, and spawns review fix sub-agents when needed.
